test.command: PATH=".venv-ag-tests/bin:$PATH" make test && if [ -f Cargo.toml ] || [ -f rust-ag/Cargo.toml ]; then cargo test --workspace -- --test-threads=5; else echo "No Rust workspace yet; skipping Rust tests"; fi

typecheck.command: if [ -f Cargo.toml ] || [ -f rust-ag/Cargo.toml ]; then cargo check --workspace; else echo "No Rust workspace yet; skipping typecheck"; fi

lint.command: if [ -f Cargo.toml ] || [ -f rust-ag/Cargo.toml ]; then cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; else echo "No Rust workspace yet; skipping Rust lint"; fi

blockingIssues.description: Memo includes numeric factual claims without claim-ID linkage (e.g. scenario count statement), violating claim-evidence linkage expectations.
publication/check_claims.py numeric-claim regex does not cover bare numeric claims, allowing unsupported numeric statements to pass publication gate checks.
Memo adversarial Q&A IQR range claim (0.10–0.53 ms) is inconsistent with cited sampling_validation artifact values (0.148–0.377 ms).
publication/claim_evidence_map.json CLM-ADV-003 repeats the incorrect IQR range, propagating inaccurate evidence-linked claim data.
publication/traceability_check.py reads parity commit SHA but does not enforce parity/memo/benchmark commit equality, leaving lineage gaps undetected.
Traceability reproducibility validation only checks file presence and does not execute a clean-checkout smoke reproducibility run on the cited commit.

appliedUpdates.description: Added publication validator command aliases for validate_metrics_tables, style_gate, and license_audit to standardize scrutiny/user-testing command references.
Updated .factory/library/publication.md to document sampling_validation.json as authoritative evidence source for uncertainty stats (IQR/CI) in memo/Q&A claims.
